mods.name: Skyblock Shopping List
mods.description: Hypixel SkyBlock shopping-list HUD. Tracks the items in your inventory, sacks and storage, and shows what you still need for the recipes you pick. Read-only and client-side.

releases.notes:
First release on CurseForge.

Recent changes:
- Mob drops panel: kills-left estimates per drop, counted by the mob that died, with your Magic Find shown at the bottom
- Event drops: a ! on rows you can farm during a running mayor event
- Recipe button on shopping list rows
- Earlier list entries now get stock before later entries craft
- New clipboard mod icon
- Panel layout fixes: title gap, dividers and border drawn correctly
- UI text moved to a lang file, so resource packs can translate it

mods.name: Skyblock Shopping List
mods.description: Hypixel SkyBlock shopping-list HUD. Tracks the items in your inventory, sacks and storage, and shows what you still need for the recipes you pick. Read-only and client-side.

releases.notes:
## New
- **Mob drops panel**: a new panel, off by default, for list items that drop from mobs. For each item it shows kills since the last drop and estimates the kills left in three cases:
  - **Best**: lucky with your Magic Find.
  - **You**: average with your Magic Find.
  - **Worst**: average with no Magic Find.
  
  Only kills of mobs that drop the item count, and the drop chance used is the one for the mob you are fighting. Guaranteed drops are left out. A RARE DROP message resets the count. Magic Find comes from the Misc Stats line in Your SkyBlock Profile, the tab list or the last RARE DROP message, or you can set it in Settings. The panel's bottom line shows the value in use and where it came from.

This is experimental, it has issues tracking multi kills.

- **Powder goals**: Mithril, Gemstone and Glacite powder are read from the tab list, so you can put goals such as 50,000 Mithril Powder on your list.
- **Share lists**: each saved list has a Copy button that puts a share code on your clipboard. Paste saves a list from a code without changing your current list.
- **HUD progress bars** (optional): rows fill up as you get closer to finishing them. Recipe trees and the Total have separate settings: Off, Top level, Down to 1st level or Every row.
- **Item descriptions**: hover a recipe in the menu to see the item's description.
- **Notifications**: each notification (Ready to craft, Item achieved, Sacks to open, Sack reminder) can be set to Off, Chat, Toast or Both. Toasts now work with notification mods such as FancyNotify.
- **New option, "Deepest steps first"** (Settings > List, off by default): items you hold go first to the ingredient with the most crafting steps under it.

**Optional mod support**:
  - SkyBlock Item List: a ☰ button on its recipes adds the item to your list, and its item grid stays clear of the HUD.
  - Mod Menu: Configure opens Settings.


## Changed
- **Menu**: every tab now uses the same layout and colours. The recipe search and filters are shared across the List, Recipes and Forge tabs, and carry over when you switch.
- **Move HUD**: the background is now see-through, and panels snap to screen edges, the centre and each other.
- **Forging section**: can be set to All, Listed or Off. All is the new default and shows every forge slot. Items not on your list appear in their own colour, red by default.
- **Forge tab**:
  - Rows are red while anything is missing, yellow when you can craft them from what you hold, and green when covered.
  - Colours update as you pick up items.
- **Forge times**: rounded up on the HUD.
- **Held items**: drill parts installed in a drill and gemstones socketed in items now count as held.
- **Sacks to open notification**: also fires when you raise an amount in the box or load a saved list. It only repeats when the sacks to open change.
- **Removed**: the old `/ir` command aliases. Use `/ssl` and `/ssl menu`.
- **New mod icon.**

## Fixed
- Recipes that make several items per craft (for example 1 Blaze Rod makes 2 Blaze Powder) no longer ask for twice the materials.
- An earlier list entry now gets your stock before a later entry can use it for crafting.
- Total rows count everything you hold of an item, including stock assigned to deeper steps.
- Opening a sack corrects counts that had drifted.
- Gems in armour you are wearing are no longer counted twice.
- Forge recipes no longer show up twice in the recipe picker (for example the Divan pieces), and old forge entries are gone.
- Recipes whose ingredients share a name with another item now use the right ingredient (for example Beastmaster Crest tiers and Spirit Sceptre).
- Very large amounts no longer wrap around to negative numbers.
- List amount boxes save when you leave the box, and go back to the previous amount if you leave them empty or at 0.
- The welcome message shows your actual key bindings.
- Recipe data downloads again if any of its files are missing.
- HUD text is measured again after a font change.

releases.notes:
## 4.28.1

### New
- **Total panel:** Total can now have its own panel, which you move, resize and scale in Move HUD, like Craftable and Forging.
- **Total levels:** a slider to list raw materials, or the steps in between (levels 1–5).
- **Hide finished rows:** ingredients you already have enough of drop off the HUD (on by default).

### Changed
- Settings is split into **Settings / Appearance / Advanced** tabs.
- Loading a saved list skips "Have total" entries that are already done.

### Fixed
- Armor put back in the wardrobe or a loadout is counted again. Open each wardrobe page once to refresh.

### Docs
- New [wiki](https://github.com/Toakan/Skyblock-Shopping-List/wiki) with a guide to every feature, plus screenshots and GIFs.
- Jar security scan report: [security/java-triage](https://github.com/Toakan/Skyblock-Shopping-List/tree/master/security/java-triage).

**Full changelog:** [4.27.1...4.28.1](https://github.com/Toakan/Skyblock-Shopping-List/compare/4.27.1...4.28.1)
